736810101.text: Hello, Traveler, Paimon. I've heard that you've been participating in the Fecund Hamper event. Was it fun?

736810102.text: It's been pretty fun! Paimon isn't sure if it's because there was this market during Weinlesefest, but we got all sorts of decorations.

736810103.text: Haha, there are indeed people who would prepare those as gifts. Right, since we're running a snack shop, do you want to put some of those decorations here?

736810104.text: Prettying the shop up could help us attract more customers.

736810105.text: Besides, I'm sure the gift givers would be happy to see their sincere gifts being used in your shop.

736810106.text: #Good point! C'mon, {NICKNAME}, let's decorate our shop!
